title: Xbox says GTA VI will not stream to PC
summary: Xbox chief strategy officer Matthew Ball corrected a report that Xbox Cloud Gaming would carry the game. He wrote that it “will not be streaming exclusively or to PC.”

title: GamesBeat reports a PC release in early 2027
summary: Four unnamed industry sources told GamesBeat that Rockstar plans a PC version “within the first three months of 2027.” Rockstar did not respond before publication and has announced nothing.

title: Take-Two removes GTA V ports from GitHub the day before launch
summary: Four notices took down unofficial GTA V ports for phones, Macs and browsers along with their forks. Take-Two wrote that a “bring your own files” disclaimer does not shield a project that helps people run the game.

title: A fake GTA 6 PC download kit is for sale
summary: NordVPN’s threat team found a $200 kit that bundles a wallet drainer, a cookie stealer named “GTA6 Keygen.exe” and a hidden crypto miner. Researchers later traced more than 355 domains serving fake launchers.

title: GTA VI launches on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S
summary: Rockstar’s page lists the two consoles and no PC version. Both run the game at 30 fps.

title: An Xbox Series build leaks without its executable
summary: A leaker called Cyberleek published about 200 GB of game files and held back the main executable until 23 November, predicting the community would have it “emulated inside a week, running far past 30fps.” Take-Two’s notice dates the distribution to 20 November and calls the files stolen.

title: Leonida and the first Xbox projects open on GitHub
summary: Leonida set out to recompile the Xbox build into a Windows program and translated all 26,503 of its shaders before it had an executable to run. XCL, Xbox2Windows, ScarlettX, AnyXboxX and an emulator based on TomBox started the same week.

title: The missing executable is released
summary: Cyberleek published the Xbox executable and wrote that “the torch passes to the open source recomp and emulation projects.” PC Gamer could not verify the file.

title: VIctory is published and reaches the game’s menus
summary: Marvisak published VIctory, a Rust layer that runs the Xbox code directly on Windows. PortWatch reported a livestream of the menus the same day. Most builds that play the game now are forks of it.

title: Leonida loses its Discord server and its lead
summary: The project’s server of about 180,000 members was removed. Its 15-year-old lead, NotRexed, wrote “I quit guys” and said the takedown was only part of the reason.

title: GitHub disables Leonida and 3,007 repositories
summary: Take-Two’s notice cites section 2.3 of Rockstar’s terms, which bars reverse engineering, and says the files a user must supply can only be the leaked ones. GitHub applied it to the whole fork network.

title: The first builds walk around the prologue at 2 to 5 fps
summary: Clips posted on 24 and 25 November show Lucia’s prison prologue with textures, lighting and controller input. One ran at 1 to 3 fps on an RTX 5070 Ti with a Ryzen 7 7800X3D.

title: At least six builds reach gameplay and one gets to “Gone Fishing”
summary: Notebookcheck counted at least six builds in interactive gameplay. The furthest finished the prologue and reached Jason’s first mission. Broken shadows, blown-out lighting and crashes were common.

title: AvatarManz’s fork is reported at about 16 fps
summary: PC Gamer’s explainer lists AvatarManz, DexNom, Belobug, hyphennn and Uilian as the leading builds, all forks of VIctory.

title: A PS5 copy is shown running on a jailbroken console
summary: Videos show a 540 GB dump with a decrypted executable on PS5 firmware 11.60. Notebookcheck names KytyPS5 as a possible route to PC and says much work remains. No PS5 project has shown the game running.

title: A tracker account predicts 30 fps by the weekend
summary: The “Is GTA 6 on PC” account on X wrote “GTA 6 on PC at 30 fps maybe during or after this weekend.” No project has published a date of its own.

title: ZETTROX’s repository goes offline
summary: The build that led PortWatch’s ranking a day earlier now returns a 404, and so does the owner’s account. GitHub has published no notice for it.

title: GitHub promotes AnyPS5, then deletes the post
summary: GitHub’s account on X celebrated 58,000 stars for the PS5 relinker two days after the Leonida takedown and later removed the post. AnyPS5 has not shown GTA VI running.

title: Vice-Tay logs a 30 minute session at 21 fps
summary: Its README reports the prologue played by hand through the boat section on an RTX 4090, with a median of 21.1 fps on the Series S profile. Nobody outside the project has confirmed it.

title: VIctory-RDNA reports a 23 fps median at 4K
summary: The new fork measures 23.1 fps in gameplay and 19.1 in heavy scenes on a Radeon RX 7900 XT with ray tracing off. The figures are its own.

title: Two Mac ports get into the game’s opening
summary: VIctory for macOS reached the prologue cinematics on an M2 Max through Wine and D3DMetal. A native Metal port draws the start screen at about 30 fps and crashes a few seconds into the prologue.
